personality_one_liner: A cinematic, mysterious, and high-end radar experience that makes serendipitous connections feel like fate.

spacing.rule: Cinematic and generous. Avoid cramming elements. Use lg/xl padding to create breathing room around text and UI controls.

do_s: Use heavy glass on the bottom sheet over the map
Floating action pills/buttons overlaying the map must be glass
Pair blur with a 75%+ opacity tint of surfaceSecondary to ensure text contrast
Match alert overlay should use a full screen blur
dont_s: No blur on form inputs or dense text areas
Do not rely solely on blur for contrast; always underlay a tint

screens.name: Onboarding / Auth
screens.purpose: Introduce the cinematic vibe and get the user logged in.

states.loading: Centered brandPrimary spinner over the dark spheres image

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image (`onboarding_bg`). Mandatory vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse (#0D110F) at the bottom). Large Fraunces title at the top, bottom 30% holds login/signup buttons.

screens.name: Radar Map (Home)
screens.purpose: The core proximity experience showing nearby users via a sweeping animation.

states.loading: Map loads with skeleton grid or gentle pulsing center
states.empty: Map shows 'No one in radius', radar keeps spinning gently

screens.layout: Full-bleed react-native-maps instance. Map style strictly custom dark JSON (hiding text/roads). Overlay a Skia canvas for concentric distance rings (using border) and a rotating radar sweep arc (conical gradient, brandPrimary to transparent). Top floating pill (safe area) for current Status. Bottom holds the Nearby People bottom-sheet.

screens.name: Nearby People (Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: List density view of users found by the radar.

states.empty: Illustration/Icon with 'Sweep found no one. Increase your radius.'

screens.layout: Lives inside @gorhom/bottom-sheet over the Map. Sheet background is expo-blur heavily tinted with surfaceSecondary (75%+). Header 'Nearby' in Fraunces. Scrollable list: User avatar (left), Name & Distance (center), colored dot for status (right). Items separated by divider.

screens.name: Status Broadcasting (Modal)
screens.purpose: Allow user to pick their real-life availability.
screens.layout: Bottom-sheet or full screen blur modal. 'What's your vibe?' title. A stack of large pressable cards. Each card has a subtle icon, bold title, and description. Active card gets a borderStrong outline and a subtle brandTertiary tint. Action button sticky at bottom.

screens.name: Match Alert (Icebreaker)
screens.purpose: A dramatic, low-pressure cue that a complementary status is nearby.
screens.layout: Full screen overlay (absolute fill, heavy blur). Center content: user's avatar and the match's avatar overlapping slightly, connected by a glowing ring. Large Fraunces heading 'Paths Crossed'. A primary CTA 'Say Hi' and secondary CTA 'Dismiss'.

screens.name: Privacy Controls
screens.purpose: Adjust visibility, radius, and location sharing.
screens.layout: Standard scrolling view. surface canvas. Generous spacing. Rows of settings with toggles. A slider for 'Discovery Radius'. Use glass surfaces for the input cards. Floating CTA to save changes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the 6 Glass / Luxe personality strictly. The app should feel like a cinematic, premium radar, NOT a tactical military tracker.
Implement the radar sweep using @shopify/react-native-skia over react-native-maps. The sweep arc should be a conical gradient rotating via Reanimated.
Map must use a custom JSON style to strip out POIs, labels, and roads, matching the `#0D110F` surface color to blend seamlessly with the app background.
Every frosted glass surface (like the Bottom Sheet) MUST include a background tint (`backgroundColor: '#161B18'` at `0.75` opacity) beneath the blur layer to ensure foreground text is readable.
Apply the gradient scrim (transparent to 80% surfaceInverse/black) behind text on the onboarding background image.
No blue or purple hues allowed. Status colors are mapped to Success (Emerald), Error (Rose/Burgundy), Warning (Amber), Info (Teal).
Cap all font weights at 500 max. Rely on the display font (Fraunces) size for hierarchy.
Implement haptics on status selection, button presses, and when the radar detects a new match (radar_sweep_ping).
